interactive.label: HeteroFRET
interactive.tooltip: HeteroFRET: a donor-acceptor pair - distance, lifetime, efficiency and rate.

interactive.label: HomoFRET
interactive.tooltip: HomoFRET: energy migration between like dyes - anisotropy decay and the implied donor-acceptor distance.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through the calculator.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: The help page for the FRET calculator.

interactive.label: R
interactive.tooltip: Donor-acceptor distance. Any of distance, lifetime, efficiency or rate may be entered; the others are recomputed.

interactive.label: tau
interactive.tooltip: Donor lifetime in the presence of acceptor (D in DA). Editable input that back-computes the distance.

interactive.label: E
interactive.tooltip: FRET efficiency. Editable input that back-computes the distance.

interactive.label: kFRET
interactive.tooltip: FRET rate constant. Editable input that back-computes the distance.

interactive.label: sigma
interactive.tooltip: Width of the donor-acceptor distance distribution.

interactive.label: χ distribution
interactive.tooltip: Use a 3D non-central chi distance distribution instead of a Gaussian. Distances are never Gaussian: a Gaussian assigns weight to negative / near-zero distances, while the chi distribution is non-negative and vanishes at contact (R=0).
